reason: The cited evidence shows that active learning of MLIPs (E1) and DNN potentials (E2) can generate training sets for refractory MPEAs and HECN liquids at 3500 K, supporting the feasibility of the intervention and its application to high-temperature liquid configurations. However, no evidence is provided for the claimed 40–50% error reduction, the specific improvement in phase-space overlap, or the direct comparison to TOR-TILD’s EAM references; these quantitative predictions and the mechanism linking overlap to integration error remain unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Deep-learning potentials trained on ab initio data can replace EAM references for HEAs
Active learning captures rare high-energy liquid configurations
Improved reference–target phase-space overlap reduces thermodynamic-integration mismatch
